name: Cube Crawler
detailed_description:
Games by FreeTimeDevelopment

Created by a passionate solo indie game developer from Germany.

Overview

Dive into dangerous, endlessly varying cube-shaped dungeons with your spaceship – full of secrets, gripping atmosphere, and a unique 3D sci-fi style.

Cubes (Dungeons)

Every dungeon is a cube – made up of 6 sides (6 biomes), each with 16 rooms. Filled with diverse monsters, bosses, and room types, each cube holds challenging threats and great rewards. Visually, you'll discover something new in every run and experience a dungeon crawler like never before.

Spaceships

Choose your favorite spaceship from five distinct classes, each offering unique properties, and explore as much of each cube as you can. Currently, five ships await you – one per class – with more planned for future updates.

One cube. Infinite paths. The room cards are YOUR key.

As if infinite cubes weren’t enough – you can use collected room cards to manipulate the cube and expand your exploration even further. It matters where you insert a card (which represents a new room). Be smart and try to locate the activation room to unlock the best abilities in the long run.

Time as your enemy

The longer you stay on a cube, the more dangerous it becomes. Monsters level up and evolve new, unpredictable attack patterns – don’t linger too long.

Replay value

Thanks to the seed system, each cube can be replayed exactly – with room content intentionally shifting to keep the experience fresh. Challenge yourself, test new builds, and see how far you can go with different skills or routes. Share your seed with friends – maybe they’ll choose a different path?

Encounter the unexpected

You’ll find the following 10 room types: Common, Room Card, Boss, Activation, Artifact (¹), Passive Gear, Active Gear, Treasure, Merchant (¹), Gaming (¹)

Chance? Fate? Chaos? – Shape the Unknown.

The passive and active equipment you find in the dungeons is governed by a rarity system: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, and Legendary.

The advanced buff system keeps you informed at all times. You can always check your current attributes – including changes and modifiers.

Collect Cube Coins (temporary currency) during your runs to unlock new actions and progress further.

Collect Dark Matter (permanent currency) and activate enough cubes to unlock the most powerful skills in the Skill Tree.

Unlock essential abilities across six categories: Combat, Shield, Structure, Technology, Environment, and Universal. With the right skills, you’ll be well equipped to survive long runs through the cubes.

Statistic or memory? With every journey, your universe grows.

Over time, you’ll build your own universe – as every played cube is stored in your profile. This gives you a clear overview of your best explorations and lets you revisit past cubes at any time.

(¹) These features are currently in development and may not be fully implemented during the Early Access release.

short_description: Take on the challenge and discover a completely new 3D sci-fi dungeon crawler. The sophisticated room card mechanics and endless generated dungeons with the form of a cube, this game is unique in this genre. What will you discover while exploring?
supported_languages:
English*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Russian*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-6300 (4 Cores)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 (6 Cores)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
